description: The datasheets a report's charts and tables are built from, with their source and when each was last read. An entry whose `copyOf` is set repeats that datasheet for one more element of a slide: it shows the same data and is read together with it, so count each piece of data once by skipping the entries with a `copyOf`. Only a datasheet a slide shows has a `lastBuiltAt`.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. Only reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck` work here: another type, such as a Google Slides presentation, returns `400`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/slides/`.

name: listReportDatasheets
title: List report datasheets
